title: Replicants Fight Back in New Blade Runner 2099 Trailer!
summary: Have you ever rooted for the robots in a movie? In the Blade Runner world, replicants are bioengineered humans who look just like us but are treated like slaves. For over 40 years, fans have waited for them to fight back. Now, a new TV series called Blade Runner 2099 is finally showing that rebellion! The first trailer just dropped at San Diego Comic-Con, and it looks awesome. The show takes place 50 years after the last film, Blade Runner 2049. Los Angeles has been rebuilt—but not by humans. Replicants have taken over! The story follows Cora, a fugitive who becomes a Blade Runner (a special cop who hunts replicants). She teams up with Olwen, a replicant played by the amazing Michelle Yeoh, who only has days to live. Together, they chase a runaway who holds a secret that could destroy their fragile city. The series has eight episodes and will stream on Prime Video starting November 25, 2026. With stunning visuals and a gripping story, this might be the sequel fans have been dreaming of. Will the replicants finally get justice? We can't wait to find out!
why_it_matters: This story makes us ask: should artificial beings have rights, and what does it mean to be truly free?

The famous actress Michelle Yeoh plays Olwen, a replicant with only days to live. The trailer premiered at San Diego Comic-Con, a big convention where pop culture announcements are made.
